name: Porcelain Heart
source:
Porcelain Heart is the story of a doll who gets a chance to live. A fickle entity has decided to play a game with her. He will grant her wish but only for 1 month, if she wishes to remain human she has to get a guy to give his heart to her. And so the game of finding love begins.

[From [url=http://blackwitchproject.vnovel.com/uncategorized/porcelain-heart-demo-2]Black Witch Project[/url]]
translation:
《瓷心》讲述了一个获得生命机会的娃娃的故事。一个喜怒无常的存在决定与她玩一场游戏。他会实现她的愿望，却只给她一个月的时间；如果她想继续做一个人类，就必须让一个男人向她献出真心。寻找爱情的游戏就这样开始了。

[摘自[url=http://blackwitchproject.vnovel.com/uncategorized/porcelain-heart-demo-2]Black Witch Project[/url]]
